resolved_conflicts.explanation: The two Oregon pages say Wallowa County. A Washington index entry under the same name says Columbia County. The Oregon pages are the register and a dedicated lookout page; the index is a secondary list, so the record's Wallowa County is kept. No source reconciles the two.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the register and firelookout.com give only a 1941 (possibly 1935) cabin, abandonment and loss. No staffing, fire or removal-year sources were found. Two searches and a handful of reads turned up nothing more. The FFLOS list page gives coordinates 45.99474, -117.95819, while the detail page the record uses gives 46.009306, -117.961881; the detail-page point matches the record, so no correction is proposed, but the list point differs by about 1.7 km. The Washington index text is a short listing, not a site history. The Paradise Fire of July 2026 near Walla Walla is a different event and is not linked to this site.
